chatParticipants.name: npm-advisor
chatParticipants.description: Ask about your npm dependencies: security, licenses, alternatives, scores.

npmAdvisor.targetLicense.description: Project license used to evaluate dependency license compatibility (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0).

npmAdvisor.unmaintainedThresholdDays.description: Number of days since the last commit to a dependency's GitHub repo before NPM Advisor flags it as unmaintained.

npmAdvisor.advisorySeverityFloor.description: Lowest GitHub Security Advisory severity that produces a Problems-panel diagnostic, and the default severity floor for the All packages dependency view (use 'Show all severity levels' there to include lower-severity advisories). Lower-severity advisories are ignored.

npmAdvisor.outdatedMajorThreshold.description: Number of major versions a dependency can be behind the latest published release before NPM Advisor flags it as outdated.

enumDescriptions: Never run automatically. You can still run a check from the Project Health view.
Run a dependency health check (vulnerabilities + licenses across every package.json) once per day and notify you with a summary.
npmAdvisor.projectHealth.autoRun.description: Automatically run the workspace-wide dependency health check (vulnerabilities and license compatibility across every package.json) once a day and notify you of the result. On by default; the slower project analysis is never run unattended. You can also toggle this from the Project Health > Dependencies view, or turn it off from the daily notification.

virtualWorkspaces.description: NPM Advisor reads package.json and lockfiles from disk, runs dependency and security analysis, and can apply a migration codemod that rewrites files, none of which work over a virtual file system.
